inspections.finding: The whole initial kaf descends from its lower body through a short saturated connection into a thick leftward terminal. It does not independently delimit the lower point from the consonant. Literal kaf hiriq in כי also fuses into the lower body; kaf sheva in כאב has a vertical pair, while kaf qamats in כאניה has a descending stem and broader shoulders. The target fused terminal lacks enough subdivisions to distinguish an obscured node, bar, or fused pair. Retain the vowel disclosure; neither a specific vowel nor source absence is certified.

At the higher reader zoom, the complete bet ends above a separate, continuous, flat horizontal lower bar. The bar has no central descending stem and no resolved horizontal or vertical pair of nodes. It matches the literal patah under het in בחנת and resh in ברחמים. Literal bet qamats in בחנת has a substantial central descent; literal bet sheva in ברחמים has two vertically separated nodes; literal qof tsere in תנקם has two horizontal nodes; the hiriq below the tav there is a single compact node. The target bar remains continuous across its width at both captured viewer zooms. Certify U+05B7 after the existing bet dagesh, preserving the previous combining order.

The whole het has a flat horizontal left bar, with a separate right pair of vertically aligned nodes. The left component does not descend below its bar. Literal same-page het in ברחמים and alef in אשר have the same bar-plus-pair structure. Literal he in היות on printed474 has the additional lower central/left node of hataf-segol; literal alef in כאניה on printed482 has the left descending stem of hataf-qamats. Both competitors are visible in the same authorized Chrome scan and are absent from the target contour. Certify U+05B2 at the end of the existing het cluster.
